g.text: False-safe: prediction ≤ cap, measured area > cap. Seed repeats reuse the same consumed cohort; they are not independent samples.

g.text: Fresh scope: five synthetic circuit templates; no independent application-transfer or full-core claim. Sources: results/selection-stability and results/selection-validation.
